---
title: "Corrections"
---

Defects and traps found in the original data files. The original files are
never edited. Every entry here is applied by a reader at read time, so a
correction is visible, survives a re-fetch, and cannot be quietly forgotten.

`kind` says what sort of problem it is.

| Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `metadata` | An attribute states something untrue. The data is fine. |
| `trap` | The file is correct, and a natural way of reading it gives a wrong answer. |
| `truncated` | Content is missing. |
| `superseded` | A better copy of the same submission exists elsewhere. |
| `naming` | The same thing carries different names in different places. |

`status` is `confirmed` when the evidence is reproducible from what is in this
repository, and `unverified` when it rests on something outside it.

```{python}
#| echo: false
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path("../..").resolve()))
from gia_mip import corrections
from IPython.display import Markdown

rows = ["| Id | Kind | Applies to | Status |", "| --- | --- | --- | --- |"]
for e in corrections.load():
    targets = "<br>".join(f"`{p}`" for p in e["applies_to"])
    rows.append(f"| [{e['id']}](#{e['id']}) | {e['kind']} | {targets} | {e['status']} |")
Markdown("\n".join(rows))
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
blocks = []
for e in corrections.load():
    blocks.append(f"## {e['id']} {{#{e['id']}}}\n")
    blocks.append(f"*{e['kind']}, {e['status']}, found {e['discovered']}*\n")
    blocks.append("Applies to:\n")
    for p in e["applies_to"]:
        blocks.append(f"- `{p}`\n")
    if e.get("field"):
        blocks.append(f"\n**Field** `{e['field']}`\n")
    blocks.append(f"\n**As shipped** {e['as_shipped']}\n")
    blocks.append(f"\n**Correct** {e['correct']}\n")
    blocks.append(f"\n**Evidence** {e['evidence']}\n")
    blocks.append(f"\n**What a reader does** {e['action']}\n")
Markdown("\n".join(blocks))
```

## Reporting one

Finding a defect is useful. Open an issue with the file, the field, what the
file says, what you believe is true, and how you know. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/g-adopt/gia-mip/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
